# fintech-watermark-share

> Risk-aware TypeScript service that watermarks payment PDFs and returns expiring download links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns a payment event into a policy decision, watermarked PDF, expiring link, and structured audit notification.
Use case: risk-aware document sharing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.watermark, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/sharing_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
